cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(ets2_autonomy)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(ets2_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(nav_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(visualization_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(nlohmann_json REQUIRED)
# Model-predictive ACC generated by Embedded Coder; regenerate with
# apps/control/matlab/acc/generate_acc_code.m, never edit by hand.
set(ACC_GENERATED ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../apps/control/matlab/acc/generated)
add_library(acc_controller STATIC
  ${ACC_GENERATED}/ACC_Controller.cpp ${ACC_GENERATED}/ACC_Controller_data.cpp ${ACC_GENERATED}/rtGetInf.cpp
  ${ACC_GENERATED}/rtGetNaN.cpp ${ACC_GENERATED}/rt_nonfinite.cpp ${ACC_GENERATED}/coder_posix_time.c)
target_include_directories(acc_controller PUBLIC ${ACC_GENERATED})
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(acc_controller PRIVATE /bigobj /W0)
endif()
# Model-predictive lane centering, apps/control/matlab/lcc/generate_lcc_code.m. The
# rt_nonfinite/rtGet*/coder_posix_time support files are the ACC library's.
set(LCC_GENERATED ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../apps/control/matlab/lcc/generated)
add_library(lcc_controller STATIC ${LCC_GENERATED}/LCC_Controller.cpp ${LCC_GENERATED}/LCC_Controller_data.cpp)
target_include_directories(lcc_controller PUBLIC ${LCC_GENERATED})
target_link_libraries(lcc_controller PUBLIC acc_controller)
# Both generated models define these Embedded Coder utilities with external linkage.
target_compile_definitions(lcc_controller PRIVATE div_nde_s32_floor=lcc_div_nde_s32_floor
  rt_hypotd_snf=lcc_rt_hypotd_snf rt_powd_snf=lcc_rt_powd_snf)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(lcc_controller PRIVATE /bigobj /W0)
endif()
add_executable(drive_speed src/gt_drive_node.cpp)
target_compile_features(drive_speed PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(drive_speed PRIVATE /bigobj)  # the session lambda's many ROS template instances
endif()
target_link_libraries(drive_speed nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json acc_controller lcc_controller)
ament_target_dependencies(drive_speed rclcpp ets2_msgs geometry_msgs nav_msgs std_msgs)
add_executable(drive_hold src/drive_hold_node.cpp)
target_compile_features(drive_hold PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
ament_target_dependencies(drive_hold rclcpp ets2_msgs)
# HUD marks from the assistance state, apart from the control loop (hud_marks.hpp).
add_executable(hud src/hud_node.cpp)
target_compile_features(hud PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
ament_target_dependencies(hud rclcpp ets2_msgs geometry_msgs nav_msgs visualization_msgs)
install(TARGETS drive_speed drive_hold hud DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(DIRECTORY launch DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  find_package(ament_cmake_gtest REQUIRED)
  ament_add_gtest(lateral_sim_test test/lateral_sim_test.cpp)
  target_compile_features(lateral_sim_test PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
  target_include_directories(lateral_sim_test PRIVATE src)
  target_link_libraries(lateral_sim_test nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json lcc_controller)
  # Real map lane from map_lane_provider; the test skips that scenario when absent.
  target_compile_definitions(lateral_sim_test PRIVATE ETS2_LANE_FILE="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../bridge/recordings/gt-path/current-lane.json")
  ament_add_gtest(longitudinal_test test/longitudinal_test.cpp)
  target_compile_features(longitudinal_test PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
  target_include_directories(longitudinal_test PRIVATE src)
  target_link_libraries(longitudinal_test acc_controller)
endif()
ament_package()
